clue.text: Elegant work yet to come from the retired Laureate?

definitions.text: Elegant work yet to come from the retired Laureate?

parts.words: Elegant work yet to come from the retired Laureate
parts.note: verse still being written, under way, by a poet who has left the post, read as a phrase for anything graceful

explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, a retired Poet Laureate's unfinished verses are still being worked on; the phrase as a whole is the idiom for something moving beautifully.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes graceful, flowing movement, such as an athlete or dancer at their best, so it is a fitting label for elegant work.

clue.text: Gas ring section

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
a zone is an area or section

explanation.surface: Part of a gas cooker's ring.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a form of oxygen with three atoms per molecule, a pale blue gas.

clue.text: Tests restricting university to smaller lessons

indicators.note: the tests hold the other letters in, confining them within

parts.note: trials are tests
taken as written

explanation.surface: Exams keep a university to smaller teaching sessions.
explanation.definitionFit: These are teaching sessions for one student or a small group, smaller than lectures.

clue.text: Zulu follows this Union soldier

definitions.meaning: in the NATO phonetic alphabet the code word for Y comes just before Zulu
a Northern soldier in the American Civil War

explanation.walkthrough: Zulu suggests the African people, but it is the last word of the NATO alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Southern Confederates called Northern troops by this name, and the alphabet uses it as the code word for Y.

clue.text: See 1
Hot sauce ideal or otherwise, snack won't satisfy me!

indicators.note: the letters are put in another way, rearranged

explanation.surface: A diner says hot sauce is ideal, but a mere snack won't do.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the idiom of someone ravenously hungry, for whom a light snack falls far short.

clue.text: Second one leaving African countries to avoid duty

indicators.note: departing, so that letter is taken out

parts.note: Mali and Niger are neighbouring West African countries
one is I, and it is the second I of the pair that goes

explanation.surface: A second person leaves the African nations to dodge their obligations.
explanation.walkthrough: Of the two I's in MALI and NIGER, the second, in NIGER, is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: To pretend illness to get out of work is to shirk duty.

clue.text: Symbol seen in Ceto Temple

indicators.note: the answer can be spotted inside the run of letters

explanation.surface: A symbol is visible in a temple to the sea goddess Ceto.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved pole or object is an emblem of a clan or family, so it is a symbol.

clue.text: Bad luck is remote possibility

parts.note: food gone bad is off
chance is luck

explanation.surface: Bad luck is only a slim possibility.
explanation.definitionFit: An unlikely but possible event is said to happen on this, a slim prospect.

clue.text: Otto and new wife dressed in fresh material

indicators.note: Otto and companions are clothed by the outer word, so they sit inside it

parts.note: fresh weather is cool
the name taken as written
W is the genealogical abbreviation for wife

explanation.surface: A man called Otto and a new wife wear clothes made of fresh fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Fluffy cotton fibre sold in balls and pads is a soft material used for cleaning and padding.

clue.text: Female in good shape backing little Barney?

indicators.note: going backwards, so the word for healthy is read from right to left

parts.note: someone in good shape is fit

explanation.surface: A shapely woman is supporting someone small called Barney.
explanation.walkthrough: Barney looks like a man's name, but a barney is British slang for a noisy quarrel; a little one is a minor squabble.
explanation.definitionFit: A small, petty quarrel is a minor row; the question mark flags the slang use of barney.

clue.text: Given thrashing, all three learn

indicators.note: the words are beaten about, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: All three pupils were beaten and so learned their lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to find out by report, as in 'I hear tell you're moving', so it fits learning of something.

clue.text: New York politician quiet about pretty females

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: turning about, the request for silence is read backwards

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: A New York politician hushes up a scandal involving attractive women.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth these are beautiful nature spirits, and the word is used of attractive young women generally.

clue.text: Faustina regularly seen in vast region

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals, every other one from the name

explanation.surface: A woman named Faustina is often spotted somewhere huge.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the largest continent, so a vast geographical region describes it well.

clue.text: Could this be M's part? Yes!

definitions.text: Could this be M's part? Yes!

indicators.note: asks whether the letters given could be rearranged into the answer

parts.note: the letters taken as written, ignoring the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Asking whether this is the role of M, the head of MI6 in the James Bond films.
explanation.definitionFit: M in the Bond stories heads the secret intelligence service, a chief of spies, so the role fits.

clue.text: No odd number in service

parts.note: a number that is not odd is even
a number is a song or piece of music

explanation.surface: No odd number of hymns appears in the church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' looks like arithmetic after 'odd', but here it is a musical number, a song.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Anglican evening prayer service, so it is one kind of church service.

clue.text: Only one vest being worn?

parts.note: a singlet is a sleeveless vest
clothes being worn are on

explanation.surface: Wearing just one vest.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a vest is an undershirt; a singlet is the same garment.
explanation.definitionFit: This means a single individual item, the only one of its kind in a set.

clue.text: Silver reworked used in Christian emblem

parts.note: AG is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: the letters are worked again into a new order

explanation.surface: Silver is melted down and reshaped for use in a religious emblem.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lamb of God, depicted carrying a flag, is a symbol of Christ.

clue.text: Sense agreement amongst rowing crew

indicators.note: the word of assent goes among the crew's letters, inside them

parts.note: a racing eight is a rowing boat with eight oarsmen
yes expresses agreement

explanation.surface: A rowing crew finds common sense in agreeing with one another.
explanation.definitionFit: Vision is one of the five senses, the faculty of seeing.

clue.text: Xmas verse removed from fictional work

indicators.note: the verse letter is taken out of the book

parts.note: a novel is a long work of fiction

explanation.surface: A Christmas poem is cut from a work of fiction.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a French-derived word for Christmas, seen on cards and in carols.

clue.text: Row in which Frenchman died, shot

indicators.note: the Frenchman sits within the row

parts.note: a file is a row or line
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur

explanation.surface: A quarrel in which a Frenchman died after being shot.
explanation.walkthrough: Row suggests a quarrel, but here it is a line, a file.
explanation.definitionFit: A scene that has been shot on camera has been recorded on film.

clue.text: Good meal for all to see including a cake

indicators.note: the film rating comes along with the a, placed after it

parts.note: to have a meal is to eat, so 'ate'
U is the British film certificate for a universal audience

explanation.surface: A good public meal including a cake.
explanation.walkthrough: U is the British film classification for films suitable for everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a rich, elaborate cake, often layered with cream or fruit.

clue.text: Former partner, cunning, up for bonus

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means read backwards

parts.note: art is craft or cunning

explanation.surface: A cunning former partner is up for a bonus payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Something additional, beyond what is due, is a bonus.

clue.text: Very fine hotel used by Qantas?

parts.note: H is Hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
Qantas is an example of an airline, the Australian national carrier

explanation.surface: A very fine hotel favoured by the Australian carrier Qantas.
explanation.definitionFit: A crack this narrow is thin as a strand of hair, so the word describes something extremely fine.

clue.text: Very much lacking in purpose?

definitions.meaning: second meaning: with no aim or goal

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes 'end' as aim, so having none means having no purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an informal intensifier meaning enormously, and read literally it means without any goal.

clue.text: Copy something tried and trusted primarily

indicators.note: in the first place, so the initials of the following words

explanation.surface: Copy something proven and reliable.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for photostat, a photocopy of a document.

clue.text: Secret affair an elusive universal presence

parts.note: something kept dark is kept secret
an affair is a matter or business

explanation.surface: A clandestine love affair is hard to pin down but always there.
explanation.definitionFit: Physicists think undetected mass pervades the cosmos, inferred only from its gravity, so it is everywhere yet hard to observe.

clue.text: Engineer's instrument is one not working

parts.note: an organ is a musical instrument

indicators.note: without, so the letters for working are dropped from the word

parts.note: on means working, functioning

explanation.surface: An engineer's musical instrument has one part that is broken.
explanation.walkthrough: Take ON (working) out of ONE to leave E.
explanation.definitionFit: To engineer something is to arrange or set it up, a verb sense matching to organise.

clue.text: Dundee changed strip

indicators.note: the Scottish city's name is altered, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: The Dundee football team got a new strip.
explanation.walkthrough: Dundee is a city in Scotland, and in Britain a 'strip' is also a team's kit, which the surface plays on.
explanation.definitionFit: To strip something is to lay it bare, the verb sense of making naked.
